affected_party: quality reviewers, incident owners, operators, and stakeholders relying on a prior closure
actual_problem: a signal received after closure cannot be evaluated, linked, and governed without either mutating the original closure or leaving the reopen decision as prose
why_it_matters: late evidence can reveal false assurance, but ungoverned reopening can also destabilize accountable decisions and erase audit history
why_now: QIF v0.8.10 now closes incidents structurally and explicitly names late-signal reopening as the next missing executable boundary
